Objective

Create FuzzyNameMatcher pure domain service with 3-step matching: exact \(case-insensitive\), normalized \(strip middle initials, flip comma format\), and Jaro-Winkler fuzzy \(0.85 threshold\). In-process implementation, no external dependencies.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Exact match: Brian Miller = Brian Miller \(score 1.0\)
  • Normalized: Brian K Miller matches Brian Miller \(score 0.95\)
  • Fuzzy: typos matched via Jaro-Winkler at 0.85+ threshold
  • No match below threshold returns null
  • Handles comma format \(De La Cruz, Maria\)
  • Pure static methods, comprehensive unit tests
